svg.text: A variable stores the NeoPixel strip
Keep Button A. In on start, set strip to
P16, 8 LEDs, RGB (GRB), then show white.
Will the lights wait for Button A?
At startup the eight LEDs show white.
A still sends the two motor commands.
The lights are not light-controlled yet.
Which blocks belong in on start?
Use Bricks4Kidz motors and an eight-LED
NeoPixel strip on P16 in RGB (GRB) mode. Lift
the wheels for bench tests. The basic driving
